concept: A quote you've sent as a paper dart, folded from the printed quote itself, on a butter-yellow table, rendered in 3D (Blender) and shot from the same side three ways. Whole, from above: QUOTE on one wing, VALID FOR 30 DAYS on the other. Low: the same dart in focus and, behind it, every earlier quote where it came down, going soft. Then from higher: it has come down on an open diary, nose on Thursday's entry, Ring Mrs Hall, fence quote. Butter yellow, paper white, black serif and one petrol teal.
